name: Indie sleaze
description: Mid-2000s to early 2010s: metallic bodysuits, lame leggings, shutter shades, high-top Converse; American Apparel, Balenciaga Motorcycle Bags.

name: Steampunk
description: Victorian-style corsets, bodices, skirts, waistcoats, jackets, brass goggles, bowler and pith helmets, gadget belts.

name: Karasu-zoku
description: 1980s Tokyo crow tribe: exclusively all-black androgynous outfits, frayed midi skirts, billowy trousers, tied to Comme des Garcons and Yohji Yamamoto.

name: Takenoko-zoku
description: Harajuku 1970s-80s dancers in Harlem suits: bright loose Middle-Eastern-like outfits with ribbons, plates, dolls and brooches.

name: Cybercore
description: Black PVC or leather trench coats, sharp monochrome suiting, tech prints, tiny Matrix sunglasses, latex, rhinestone low-rise jeans.

name: Health goth
description: Monochrome technical sportswear with combat gear and bionic-style elements.

name: Chav
description: British youth stereotype in sportswear: tracksuits, puffer jackets, baseball caps, white sneakers.

name: Glam rock
description: Bright bold outfits, colourful fur coats, glittery tops, platform boots.

name: Vaporwave
description: Retro windbreakers, tinted sunglasses, graphic sweatshirts, chunky sneakers, cassette accessories.

name: Beatnik
description: Black sweaters and berets.

name: Hipster
description: Skinny cuffed jeans, fashionable boots, expensive brands mixed with vintage, thick-framed glasses.

name: Geek chic
description: Dark graphic tees, casual jeans, sweater vests, horn-rimmed glasses.

name: Reggaetonero
description: Men: wide clothes, caps, brands; women: tight clothes, gold jewellery, sunglasses.

name: Rastafari style
description: Dreadlocks, sandals, loose comfortable clothes in red, yellow and green.

name: Ouji (boy style Lolita)
description: Masculine Lolita: prince pants, masculine blouses and top hats.

name: Yamanba
description: Extreme ganguro: silver hair, white eye makeup and lipstick set against deep tan, candy-colour outfits.

name: Gyaruo (gal-o)
description: Male gyaru: styled big blond hair, deep tan, flashy accessories.

name: LA gyaru
description: Gyaru modelled on Los Angeles fashion: wheat-tan skin and colourful primary-colour outfits.

name: Amuraa
description: Copies singer Namie Amuro: long boots, straight long hair, her make-up.

name: Salon boys
description: Stylists' look: designer pieces mixed with vintage, belts, classic hats, retro glasses.

name: Kireime kei
description: Neat, classic, well-fitted clothes: nice jeans, crisp shirts, good shoes, corduroy jackets.

name: JK uniform fashion
description: Japanese schoolgirl uniform worn as fashion: Western-style blouse, skirt, vest, cardigan, or sailor suit with collar stripes.

name: Shamate
description: Eye make-up, studded leather, slashed jeans, fishnets, large colourful spiky hair; from Visual Kei, goth, punk.

name: Cyberpunk hanfu
description: Hanfu recoloured and re-fabricated with a bold, dark cyberpunk look.

name: Jejemon
description: Stereotyped Filipino youth look: black shirts, brown pants or joggers, hip-hop gangsta clothing; high-crown caps.

name: Ah Beng and Ah Lian (Singapore)
description: 1990s Ah Lian: Fendi hair clips, platform shoes, high socks, Giordano windbreakers, neon backpacks; Ah Beng flamboyant.

name: Đôn chề
description: Vietnamese flashy streetwear: fake logo tees, tight jeans, eagle-wing bombers, loafers or sliders, fake gold chains.

name: Skena (Indonesia)
description: Indonesian scene-linked dress: retro clothes modified for today with accessories; band tees and vintage pieces.

name: Pokemón (Chile)
description: Angular pressed hair, emo side bangs, otaku, punk and hip-hop clothing; Chilean mid-2000s, extinct by 2012.

name: Flogger
description: Converse-style high-tops, jeans tight to the calf, loose brightly coloured tops.

name: Blokecore (ladcore)
description: Replica football shirts, Adidas track tops, good jeans and trainers; Britpop-era revival.

name: Business casual
description: Dress shirt with chinos, optional sport coat or sweater, often no tie, leather dress shoes.

name: Sartorial motorcycling (Distinguished Gentleman's Ride)
description: Tweed hacking jackets, suede gilets, denim blazers, heritage clothing on classic bikes; Prussian riding boots.

name: Apres-ski style
description: Chunky knits, quilted parkas, puffers, Nordic sweaters, fur boots worn after skiing.
